submissions.title: Submissions
submissions.description: Choose where members can submit links or screenshots and who reviews them before publication.
submissions.setup: Create a category below, then run this administrator command in Discord to post the member entry panel. Members choose a category and submit through its button and modal.
submissions.privacy: Keep review channels private: only the selected reviewer roles, administrators and the bot may view them. In destination channels, block ordinary members from sending messages and creating or replying in threads so publication requires approval.
submissions.discordOnly: Submission content and moderation stay in Discord. This page only manages configuration. Reviewers can approve, reject or request changes privately; no ticket channels are created.
submissions.empty: No categories yet. Add one to start collecting submissions.
submissions.limit: You have reached the 25-category limit. Edit or disable an existing category.
submissions.name: Category name
submissions.destinationHelp: Approved submissions are posted here. Choose a text or announcement channel, separate from the review channel.
submissions.reviewHelp: Choose a private text channel. Categories may share a review channel. Channel permissions are checked when saving.
submissions.reviewersHelp: Required: select 1–20 roles allowed to review submissions. Managed roles cannot review.
submissions.submittersHelp: Leave empty to allow everyone. Otherwise select up to 20 roles whose members may submit.
submissions.failed: Could not load or save submission settings.
submissions.retryHelp: If another administrator changed this category, close this dialog and refresh before editing again.
